review:
The oriental Megaways sequel, with wild multipliers up to 100x and an 8,000x max. Three scatters start the bonus, and scatter plus super scatter combinations trigger Super Free Spins.

You choose your bonus: five spins with 20x–100x multipliers, 25 spins with 2x–8x, options in between, or a mystery pick. Every three Level Up coins give three more spins and remove the lowest multiplier. 96.5% RTP. Great if you like choosing your risk.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
